trajectory.patch:
Based on the error log, the issue is a missing semicolon at the end of several macro definitions in `ztest_test.h`. This causes the compiler to fail with "initializer element is not constant" and "expected declaration or statement at end of input" errors when these macros are used.

The fix is to add a semicolon to the end of the variable-defining macros. While the error log only points to one usage, several related macros have the same issue. I will fix all of them to prevent future build failures.
